Extract filename from Content-Disposition header

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"download_documents\":true,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.downloadedDocument()?.mimeType() as Any)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
```
